name: Gym Exercise
lumi_text: On the Moon we weigh 6 times less than on Earth! Without 2 hours in the gym every day, muscles and bones get weak.

name: Quiet Rest
lumi_text: Even astronauts need to relax and look at Earth through the porthole to reduce stress!

name: Extra Sleep
lumi_text: Sleeping well in space is essential for keeping your reflexes sharp during the mission.

name: Clean Panels
lumi_text: Lunar dust is called regolith: it sticks everywhere like magnetic sand and blocks sunlight from reaching our panels!

name: Repair Panels
lumi_text: Great work with the tools! Going out in a spacesuit (EVA) is tiring and exposes us to cosmic rays, but now we have full power.

name: Check O₂ Machine
lumi_text: Filters cleaned and valves checked! Preventive maintenance avoids emergencies.

name: Power Saving
lumi_text: Let's dim the lights and slow down the pumps to recharge the batteries for the days ahead!

name: Grow Crops
lumi_text: LED lamps help space lettuce and radishes grow: they cost energy, but they give us fresh food!

name: Expand Greenhouse
lumi_text: We've installed a new hydroponic module! Starting tonight, we'll grow extra vegetables every day.

name: Soil Experiment
lumi_text: Let's examine lunar rocks under the microscope: this data will help scientists back on Earth!

name: Sample Polar Ice
lumi_text: At the bottom of shadowed South Pole craters lies water ice billions of years old: we can melt and study it!
